the fifth wasn't named. Synergy: PTH and calcitriol (active vitamin D) raise blood calcium together, since PTH turns on 1α-hydroxylase; T3 also works synergistically with GH on bone growth. PTH maintenance: bone through the osteoblasts, the kidney (keep calcium, dump phosphate) and the gut through calcitriol, so calcium goes up and phosphate down. The Refresher has a High Likelihood topic for each, and the mock's five follow the same split.
